title: Report the workspace structure as warnings
summary: ia validate and ia report warn when a workspace has two parents or a cycle, a parent's rules do not reach a child, a shared root has no common ancestor, a link is declared at one end only, a decides id has two listers, a source lies outside the repository, or the tree is deeper than 8. A parent or link outside the repository is reported as not checked here. The position packet shows the parent chain and the counted links. Nothing refuses yet.
